gearTalents.description: +80% Revive Speed. -50% Weakened Debuff timer. +45% Hive efficiency. Provides +50% damage resistance to both agents while reviving or being revived, and for 5s after a successful Hive Revive, or 10s after a Manual Revive. Any successful revives provide +1 Skill tier for 5s. Revives at skill tier 6 grant Overcharge for 15s.

gearTalents.name: Core Exercise
gearTalents.description: For each Core attribute, receive 40% of the other two Core Attributes' bonuses. Skill Tiers count as 15% Skill Efficiency when these bonuses are applied. All pieces from this Gear Set, apart from the Backpack, will feature random Core Attributes.

gearTalents.name: Counter
gearTalents.description: Swapping weapons will give the following groups of bonuses one by one, in order: 1. +20% Rate of Fire, +20% Weapon Damage. 2. +50% Magazine Size, +50% Reload Speed. The bonuses remain active for 12s or until the next weapon swap. Swapping to your sidearm will not trigger the next group of bonuses.

gearTalents.name: Crowd Control
gearTalents.description: Critical hits mark enemies for 20s, up to 3 marks total. When you critically hit a marked enemy, all other marked enemies take 60% of the damage dealt. Whenever a marked enemy dies, gain +10% critical hit damage, stacking up to 10 times, or until combat ends.

gearTalents.name: Dead Man's Hand
gearTalents.description: Flip a card when landing shots with a Rifle or Marksman rifle. After 5 cards are flipped, the damage of your next shot is amplified by 75%. More shots are enhanced the better the hand revealed. Four of a Kind: 4 shots. Full House: 3 shots. Aces and Eights: 2 shots. Flip an additional card on headshots.

gearTalents.name: Defibrillator
gearTalents.description: While "Shocker Punch" is equipped, the stun received by the agent from the Shock status effect will be reduced by 50%. Using a shield will give 100% to melee damage. Using St. Elmo's Engine with the holster will give 100% extra melee damage and will make the next melee attack apply shock to the target. Using all three items will offer all of the above mentioned bonuses and the Shock from the melee attack will have a 5m radius, starting from the first target. 15 second cooldown.

gearTalents.name: Dragon's Glare
gearTalents.description: While in combat, applies burn to the enemy closest to you within 20m. Cooldown: 35s.

gearTalents.name: Escape Plan
gearTalents.description: Vaulting grants +10% Movement Speed for 3s. After not moving for 5s, receive +20% Movement Speed for 5s. Being applied a Status Effect grants +10% Movement Speed for 5s. Max Movement Speed bonus is 20%. The bonuses do not stack with Movement Speed bonuses from other sources. -50% Movement Impairment penalty from Status Effects.

gearTalents.name: Feedback Loop
gearTalents.description: Whenever you use or cancel a skill, your other skill's cooldown is reduced by 30s, total skill repair is increased by 10% for 20s, and total skill damage is increased by 10% for 20s. Cooldown: 10s.

gearTalents.name: Fireworks Show
gearTalents.description: Concussion grenades become Festive Grenades. Hitting an enemy with a Festive Grenade will cause explosions to happen around two other enemies within 20m. 10m in pvp. *Dealing 15% damage in PVP.

gearTalents.name: Flurry
gearTalents.description: Status effects apply snowfall to target.

gearTalents.name: From the Shadows Into the Light
gearTalents.description: From the Shadows: While out of cover and in combat, gain 10 Stacks per second up to 50. Each stack will give 0.8% Armor regen when it is consumed. Stacks consume, 10 stacks per second, only in cover. Into the Light: While in cover, gain 10 Stacks per second up to 50. Each stack will give 1.2% Critical damage increase and 0.4% RPM. Buff does not apply while shooting from cover. While out of cover Agents lose 2 stacks per second at normal speed and 1 stack per second if sprinting.

gearTalents.name: Ground Control
gearTalents.description: Increases you and your allies' total weapon and skill damage by 15% when at full armor. When you repair an ally, you and all allies within 5m of you are also repaired for 60% of that amount.

gearTalents.name: Hackstep Protocol
gearTalents.description: Replaces armor kits with an instant, infinite-use ability. Grants 50% bonus armor for 5s. Hides your nameplate for 5s. Repairs 20% of your armor. Increases total weapon damage by 2% per 5% bonus armor gained, up to 20%. Ability cooldown: 20s.

gearTalents.name: Headache
gearTalents.description: First Headshot with a Marksman Rifle will increase next headshot by 80%, second consecutive headshot with a Marksman Rifle will give +10% armor (if at full armor it will give bonus armor max +50% of current armor value), third consecutive headshot will refill magazine. From the fourth headshot forward agents will get all 3 bonuses for each consecutive headshot kill. Missing a headshot will reset the cycle.

gearTalents.name: Heartstopper
gearTalents.description: Headshots apply pulse for 5s. Weapon hits on pulsed enemies add and refresh a stack of +1% bonus armor and +1.1% amplified weapon damage to pulsed enemies for 5s. Max stack is 50. Two stacks are lost per second.

gearTalents.name: Hoarder
gearTalents.description: +3 Grenade Capacity. +50% Grenade Radius. +35% Grenade Damage. +25% Grenade Damage for each extra enemy caught in the blast. Automatically regenerate grenades every 30s, if you have less than 2 grenades in your inventory.

gearTalents.name: Huddle
gearTalents.description: Receive +1 Skill Tier for each ally Agent that is within the range of the hive or Smart Cover. While at Skill Tier 6, having at least one ally Agent in the range of your Hive or Smart Cover for 4s will grant Overcharge for 15s. Cooldown: 40s. Mortars and enemy Skills that enter the range of your Hive or Smart Cover will be destroyed. Cooldown: 10s. The cooldown is 20% faster for each ally agent within the range of your hive or smart cover.

gearTalents.name: Impervious
gearTalents.description: Both you and Allies within 10m of you receive +40% Hazard Protection.

gearTalents.name: Indirect Transmission
gearTalents.description: On kill: Spread status effects of that enemy to all enemies within 10m. Refresh 50% of status effect durations.

gearTalents.name: Iron Grip
gearTalents.description: -50% Recoil Penalty when hip-firing. -50% Recoil Penalty when blind-firing from cover.

gearTalents.name: Kill Confirmed
gearTalents.description: Enemies you kill drop a trophy on death. Collecting trophies provides both a short and long term buff, the first of which scales with the number of core attributes equipped and lasts 10s. Red Core - 5% Weapon Damage. Blue Core - 10% Bonus Armor. Yellow Core - 5% Skill Efficiency. For every trophy collected gain an additional +1% weapon damage, +1% skill efficiency and +0.1% armor regeneration for 300s. Maximum 30 stacks.

gearTalents.name: Makeshift Repairs
gearTalents.description: Whenever you or your shield take damage, 25% of that amount is repaired to both over 10s.

gearTalents.name: On Point
gearTalents.description: Hitting a shot with a Rifle or MMR grants a stack. Max stack is equal to the weapon's Magazine Size. Reloading will grant +2% Weapon Handling and +4% Weapon Damage per stack, for 20s.  No stacks are acquired while the bonuses are active. The timer running out will refill your magazine.  Switching weapons while the bonuses are active will stop the effect and refill your magazine. Switching weapons while the bonuses are not active will remove all stacks and refill your magazine.

gearTalents.name: One in the Hand... / ...Two in the Bag
gearTalents.description: Throwing a grenade refunds it and grants +1 skill tier for 15s. Grants overcharge if already at skill tier 6. Cooldown: 60s. +1 Armor Kit Capacity. +3 Grenade Capacity. +25% Ammo Capacity. +10% Repair-Skills. +10% Status Effects.

gearTalents.name: Ortiz Incinerator Turret Prototype
gearTalents.description: The Incinerator Turret spins 360 degrees. You are immune to your own Incinerator Turret's fire. The Incinerator Turret explodes when disabled.

gearTalents.name: Ortiz Rapid Application Nanite Prototype
gearTalents.description: Healing Skills' Duration and Range are decreased by 90%, but their Healing Efficiency is increased by 150%. Healing an Ally with a Skill will provide them 30% Hazard Protection for 10s. Cooldown per ally: 10s.

gearTalents.name: Ostracize
gearTalents.description: Shooting an enemy applies a mark. Only one mark can be active at a time. The mark disappears after 15s, or when the marked enemy dies. Receive 600% Amplified Damage from the marked enemy. Deal 20% Amplified Damage to unmarked enemies. If only one enemy remains in combat, the mark disappears and cannot be reapplied.

gearTalents.name: Over the top
gearTalents.description: Damaging an enemy with a grenade or striking an enemy with a melee attack, activates Seeing Red. Seeing Red grants +25% total weapon damage and +100% melee damage. Seeing Red lasts 20 seconds and starts a 60 second cooldown after completion. While in cooldown, damaging an enemy with a melee attack or hitting an enemy with the effect of a grenade will complete the cooldown instantly.

gearTalents.name: Pack Instincts
gearTalents.description: You and all allies gain a bonus based on the distance of the last enemy you hit. 0-15m: +25% critical hit damage. 15-25m: +10% critical hit chance and +10% critical hit damage. 25m+: +25% critical hit chance.

gearTalents.name: Parkour!
gearTalents.description: Performing a cover to cover or vaulting reloads your drawn weapon and grants +25% bonus armor for 5s.

gearTalents.name: Quick Draw
gearTalents.description: While your pistol is holstered, gain a stacking buff every 0.3s, up to 100. When you swap to it, your first shot consumes the buff and deals +10% damage per stack. This deals headshot damage to anywhere you hit.

gearTalents.name: Rebalance
gearTalents.description: Getting kills and hitting enemies 3 times build Red stacks. Each stack provides 0.5% Weapon Damage. Getting hit 3 times builds Blue stacks. Each stack provides 0.5% Damage Resistance. Upon reaching 80 stacks in total, lose all stacks and receive a separate bonus of 0.5% Damage Resistance per Red stack and 0.5% Weapon Damage per Blue stack until the next time the stack cap is reached.

gearTalents.name: Red, White and Blue
gearTalents.description: Enemies you shoot receive stacking debuffs of Red/White/Blue. Changes every 2 seconds. Red: Amplifies the enemy's damage taken by 15%. White: Hitting the enemy restores you and your allies' armor by 2% once every second. Blue: Decreases enemy damage dealt by 10%. Full Flag: Enemies that die while under the effect of all three debuffs create a 5m explosion, dealing damage equal to their total health and armor. Explosion strength is reduced on Named enemy deaths.

gearTalents.name: Resourceful
gearTalents.description: Slots in with any equipped Gear Set and/or Brand Set item to fulfill a requirement towards unlocking a Gear and/or Brand Sets bonus. Can unlock bonuses from multiple sets simultaneously.

gearTalents.name: Return to Sender
gearTalents.description: For PvE: Receive repairs of 10% of the damage dealt by your Skills. Your allies will receive repairs of 20% of the damage dealt by your Skills. For PvP: Receive repairs of 5% of the damage dealt by your Skills. Your allies will receive repairs of 10% of the damage dealt by your Skills.

gearTalents.name: Rules of Engagement
gearTalents.description: Shooting a status affected enemy will apply a mark. Killing a marked enemy grants a full clip of Hollow-Point Ammo for your active weapon, and half a clip of the agent's active weapon to the rest of the party. Mark lasts for 10 seconds. Hollow-Point Ammo amplifies weapon damage by 40% and applies bleed on hit.

gearTalents.name: Slotted
gearTalents.description: Receive bonuses for each non-Core Attribute on this item, depending on their color: Red: +10% Critical Hit Damage. Yellow: +5% Skill Efficiency. Blue: +1% Armor Regen. This item can feature any Core Attribute. This item features a third random Attribute instead of having a Gear Mod Slot. This item cannot feature the Headshot Damage, Health, or Skill Repair Attributes.

gearTalents.name: Smoke Screen
gearTalents.description: On Armor break, drop a Smoke Bomb at your feet, concealing you from enemies for 3s. Cooldown: 40s.

gearTalents.name: Stand Your Ground
gearTalents.description: Cannot be staggered by explosions. Increases total weapon damage by 3% each second you are not moving. Stacks up to 10 until you start moving. All stacks lost 10s after moving.

gearTalents.name: Stoic
gearTalents.description: Get +4% Damage Resistance for every enemy that is targeting you. The bonus is multiplied by 1.X, where X is the number of agents in your group.

gearTalents.name: Striker's Gamble
gearTalents.description: Weapon hits amplify total weapon damage by 0.65%, stacking up to 100 times. 1 stack lost per second between 0 to 50 stacks; 2 stacks lost per second between 51 and 100 stacks.

gearTalents.name: Symphony
gearTalents.description: Kills Beyond 25 Meters: +40% Weapon Damage to Shotguns, SMGs, and Pistols; +20% Weapon Damage to Assault Rifles and LMGs; and +25% Bonus Armor for 15s. Kills Within 25 Meters: +40% Weapon Damage to Marksman Rifles and Rifles; +20% Weapon Damage to Assault Rifles and LMGs; and +30% Headshot Damage for 15s. Intermittently killing enemies from both ranges builds up stacks. At 4 stacks, all bonuses are multiplied by 1.5 and triggered simultaneously for 15s. No stacks gained while talent is active.

gearTalents.name: Tend and Befriend
gearTalents.description: Interacting with your deployed skills grants the skill 25% skill damage for 10s. This buff cannot be refreshed. Interactions include: Using / Deploying the Skill, Changing the skills target, Healing the skill.

gearTalents.name: Throttle Control
gearTalents.description: Shooting builds stacks to a max of 50. Each stack provides +0.5% Weapon Handling and +5% Critical Hit Damage. Lose 6 stacks per second while not shooting. No stacks are lost if an enemy is Suppressed.

gearTalents.name: Toxic Delivery
gearTalents.description: Status effects also apply a damage over time debuff for 10s. Total Damage dealt is equal to 50% of your concussion grenade damage and increased by your status effect attributes.

gearTalents.name: Transference Overclock
gearTalents.description: Grants 15% Hive skill haste per skill tier. Detonating a hive refreshes your skill cooldowns and grants overcharge for 15s. If at Skill Tier 6, this effect also applies to all allies. Allies receiving this effect are unable to benefit from it again for 120s.

gearTalents.name: Vicious Cycle
gearTalents.description: Taking damage builds stacks to a cap of 30. Each stack grants 1.5% Weapon Damage. Taking damage at max stacks triggers a purge, removing all stacks and Status Effects and then dropping a healing cloud which restores 5% of Max Armor for 10s to all allies in the cloud.

gearTalents.name: Weakest Link
gearTalents.description: Amplifies Weapon Damage by 30% to the lowest ranking enemies currently in combat, as per the Tier hierarchy. Tier 1: Hunter, Rogue, Leader, Tank, Shield, Heavy Weapons, RPG, Medic, Controller, Warhound, Marauder. Tier 2: Support, Engineer, Bodyguard, Immobilizer, Bomber, Mini Tank, Drone Operator. Tier 3: Any other enemy or skill proxy.

gearTalents.name: Spontaneous Combustion
gearTalents.description: Every Status Effect you apply has a 40% chance of also applying Burn to the enemy. If the Status Effect initially applied was Burn, the enemy will receive +25% Burn Damage for the duration of the Burn

gearTalents.name: Flashpoint
gearTalents.description: Increase the chance of applying Burn of Spontaneous Combustion to 60%

gearTalents.name: White Hot
gearTalents.description: Increase the Duration of the Burn Damage debuff of Spontaneous Combustion by +50%

gearTalents.name: Resolved
gearTalents.description: Your next body shot will be considered a headshot. Cooldown: 2s Requires Equipped: Marksman Rifle, Rifle or Pistol

weaponTalents.name: Breadbasket
weaponTalents.description: Landing body shots adds a stack of bonus +55% headshot damage to the next headshot for 10s. Max stack is 3.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Breadbasket
weaponTalents.description: Landing body shots adds a stack of bonus +70% headshot damage to the next headshot for 10s. Max stack is 2.

weaponTalents.name: Killer
weaponTalents.description: Killing an enemy with a critical hit grants +70% critical hit damage for 10s.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Killer
weaponTalents.description: Killing an enemy with a critical hit grants +90% critical hit damage for 10s.

weaponTalents.name: Preservation
weaponTalents.description: Killing an enemy repairs 10% armor over 5s. Headshot kills improve the repair by an additional 10%

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Preservation
weaponTalents.description: Killing an enemy repairs 15% armor over 5s. Headshot kills improve the repair by an additional 15%

weaponTalents.name: Optimist
weaponTalents.description: Weapon damage is increased by +3.5% for every 10% ammo missing from the magazine. (Bonus is linear across every round)

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Optimist
weaponTalents.description: Weapon damage is increased by +4.5% for every 10% ammo missing from the magazine. (Bonus is linear across every round)

weaponTalents.name: Strained
weaponTalents.description: Gain 10% critical hit damage for every 0.5s you are firing. Stacks up to 5 times.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Strained
weaponTalents.description: Gain 10% critical hit damage for every 0.5s you are firing. Stacks up to 8 times.

weaponTalents.name: Close & Personal
weaponTalents.description: Killing a target within 7m grants +30% weapon damage for 10s.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Close & Personal
weaponTalents.description: Killing a target within 7m grants +38% weapon damage for 10s.

weaponTalents.name: Fast Hands
weaponTalents.description: Critical hits add a stack of 3% reload speed bonus. Max stack is 40.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Fast Hands
weaponTalents.description: Critical hits add a stack of 5% reload speed bonus. Max stack is 40.

weaponTalents.name: Sadist
weaponTalents.description: Amplifies +30% weapon damage to bleeding enemies. After 4 kills, applies bleed to the next enemy you hit.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Sadist
weaponTalents.description: Amplifies +35% weapon damage to bleeding enemies. After 3 kills, applies bleed to the next enemy you hit.

weaponTalents.name: Eyeless
weaponTalents.description: Amplifies +30% weapon damage to blinded enemies. After 4 kills, applies blind to the next enemy you hit.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Eyeless
weaponTalents.description: Amplifies +35% weapon damage to blinded enemies. After 3 kills, applies blind to the next enemy you hit.

weaponTalents.name: Ignited
weaponTalents.description: Amplifies +25% weapon damage to burning enemies.  After 4 kills, applies burning to the next enemy you hit.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Ignited
weaponTalents.description: Amplifies +30% weapon damage to burning enemies. After 3 kills, applies burning to the next enemy you hit.

weaponTalents.name: Vindictive
weaponTalents.description: Killing an enemy with a status effect applied grants you and all allies within 15m 16% Critical hit chance and 16% critical hit damage for 20s.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Vindictive
weaponTalents.description: Killing an enemy with a status effect applied grants you and all allies within 20m 21% Critical hit chance and 21% critical hit damage for 20s.

weaponTalents.name: Ranger
weaponTalents.description: Amplifies weapon damage by 2% for every 4m you are away from your target.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Ranger
weaponTalents.description: Amplifies weapon damage by 2% for every 3m you are away from your target.

weaponTalents.name: Steady Handed
weaponTalents.description: Hits grant a stack of +1% Accuracy and Stability. At 100 stacks, consumes stacks to refill the magazine.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Steady Handed
weaponTalents.description: Hits grant a stack of +1% Accuracy and Stability. At 75 stacks, consumes stacks to refill the magazine.

weaponTalents.name: Spike
weaponTalents.description: Headshots grant +20% skill damage for 15s.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Spike
weaponTalents.description: Headshots grant +25% skill damage for 15s.

weaponTalents.name: Perpetuation
weaponTalents.description: Headshots grant +75% status effect damage and duration to the next status effect you apply. Cooldown: 20s.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Perpetuation
weaponTalents.description: Headshots grant +75% status effect damage and duration to the next status effect you apply. Cooldown: 16s.

weaponTalents.name: Reformation
weaponTalents.description: Headshots grant +60% skill repair for 15s.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Reformation
weaponTalents.description: Headshots grant +80% skill repair for 15s.

weaponTalents.name: Future Perfect
weaponTalents.description: Weapon kills grant +1 skill tier for 15s. Stacks up to 3 times. Weapon kills at skill tier 6 grant overcharge for 15s. Overcharge Cooldown: 90s

weaponTalents.name: Future Perfection
weaponTalents.description: Weapon kills grant +1 skill tier for 19s. Stacks up to 4 times. Weapon kills at skill tier 6 grant overcharge for 15s. Overcharge Cooldown: 90s

weaponTalents.name: Flatline
weaponTalents.description: Amplifies weapon damage by 15% to pulsed enemies. After 4 kills, applies pulse to the next enemy you hit.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Flatline
weaponTalents.description: Amplifies weapon damage by 20% to pulsed enemies. After 3 kills, applies pulse to the next enemy you hit.

weaponTalents.name: Sledgehammer
weaponTalents.description: Dealing damage with a grenade applies a mark on target. Targets with mark will take 15% more damage to armor from the agent that applied the mark and have a -20% movement speed. Mark will disappear after 10 seconds.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Sledgehammer
weaponTalents.description: Dealing damage with a grenade applies a mark on target. Targets with mark will take 20% more damage to armor from the agent that applied the mark and have a -30% movement speed. Mark will disappear after 10 seconds.

weaponTalents.name: Thunder Strike
weaponTalents.description: Amplifies 30% extra damage to shocked targets. After 4 kills, applies shock to the next enemy you hit.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Thunder Strike
weaponTalents.description: Amplifies 35% extra damage to shocked targets. After 3 kills, applies shock to the next enemy you hit.

weaponTalents.name: In Sync
weaponTalents.description: Hitting an enemy grants +15% skill damage for 5s. Using a skill or damaging an enemy with a skill grants +15% weapon damage for 5s. Damage increases are doubled while both buffs are active at the same time.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect In Sync
weaponTalents.description: Hitting an enemy grants +20% skill damage for 5s. Using a skill or damaging an enemy with a skill grants +20% weapon damage for 5s. Damage increases are doubled while both buffs are active at the same time.

weaponTalents.name: Pressure Point
weaponTalents.description: Amplifies weapon damage by 15% to enemies under status effects.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Pressure Point
weaponTalents.description: Amplifies weapon damage by 20% to enemies under status effects.

weaponTalents.name: Streamline
weaponTalents.description: Increase Weapon Damage by 42% when no Skills are Deployed or on Cooldown.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Streamline
weaponTalents.description: Increase Weapon Damage by 47% when no Skills are Deployed or on Cooldown.

weaponTalents.name: Immobilize
weaponTalents.description: Amplifies weapon damage by 20% to ensared enemies. After 4 kills applies Ensnare to the next enemy you hit.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Immobilize
weaponTalents.description: Amplifies weapon damage by 25% to ensared enemies. After 3 kills applies Ensnare to the next enemy you hit.

weaponTalents.name: Soft Spot
weaponTalents.description: Destroying a Weakpoint grants 19% Weapon Damage for 15s.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Soft Spot
weaponTalents.description: Destroying a Weakpoint grants 24% Weapon Damage for 15s.

weaponTalents.name: Rifleman
weaponTalents.description: Landing headshots adds a stack of bonus +10% weapon damage for 5s. Max stack is 5. Additional headshots refresh the duration.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Rifleman
weaponTalents.description: Landing headshots adds a stack of bonus +11% weapon damage for 5s. Max stack is 6. Additional headshots refresh the duration.

weaponTalents.name: Boomerang
weaponTalents.description: Critical hits have a 50% chance to return the bullet to the magazine. If a bullet is returned to the magazine the next shot gains 40% increased damage.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Boomerang
weaponTalents.description: Critical hits have a 75% chance to return the bullet to the magazine. If a bullet is returned to the magazine the next shot gains 50% increased damage.

weaponTalents.name: Lucky Shot
weaponTalents.description: Magazine capacity is increased by 20%. Missed shots from cover have a 100% chance to return to the magazine.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Lucky Shot
weaponTalents.description: Magazine capacity is increased by 30%. Missed shots from cover have a 100% chance to return to the magazine.

weaponTalents.name: Determined
weaponTalents.description: After killing an enemy with a headshot the next shot landed on any enemy will be a guaranteed headshot.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Determined
weaponTalents.description: After killing an enemy with a headshot the next shot landed on any enemy will be a guaranteed (critical) headshot.

weaponTalents.name: Behind You
weaponTalents.description: Amplifies weapon damage by +20% to enemies that are not targeting you.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Behind You
weaponTalents.description: Amplifies weapon damage by +25% to enemies that are not targeting you.

weaponTalents.name: Precision Strike
weaponTalents.description: Killing enemies farther than 20m builds up stacks. Max stack is 3. Hitting an enemy within 20m will use stacks to provide 20% amplified damage per stack to enemies within 20m for 5s.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Precision Strike
weaponTalents.description: Killing enemies farther than 20m builds up stacks. Max stack is 2. Hitting an enemy within 20m will use stacks to provide 35% amplified damage per stack to enemies within 20m for 5s.

weaponTalents.name: Near Sighted
weaponTalents.description: Receive +80% stability at the cost of -35% optimal range.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Near Sighted
weaponTalents.description: Receive +100% stability at the cost of -35% optimal range.

weaponTalents.name: On Empty
weaponTalents.description: Reloading from empty grants +60% weapon handling for 10s.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect On Empty
weaponTalents.description: Reloading from empty grants +80% weapon handling for 10s.

weaponTalents.name: Measured
weaponTalents.description: The top half of the magazine has 25% rate of fire and -25% weapon damage. The bottom half of the magazine has -18% rate of fire and +30% total weapon damage.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Measured
weaponTalents.description: The top half of the magazine has 25% rate of fire and -30% weapon damage. The bottom half of the magazine has -18% rate of fire and +38% total weapon damage.

weaponTalents.name: Overflowing
weaponTalents.description: Every 3 reloads from empty increases your base magazine capacity by 100%.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Overflowing
weaponTalents.description: Every 2 reloads from empty increases your base magazine capacity by 100%.

weaponTalents.name: Stabilize
weaponTalents.description: Firing your weapon increases Weapon Accuracy by 1% and Weapon Stability by 1% per shot up to 60%. If you stop firing, the bonuses reset after 4 seconds.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Stabilize
weaponTalents.description: Firing your weapon increases Weapon Accuracy by 1% and Weapon Stability by 1% per shot up to 75%. If you stop firing, the bonuses reset after 6 seconds.

weaponTalents.name: Naked
weaponTalents.description: Hitting an enemy with no armor grants +50% headshot damage for 5s.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Naked
weaponTalents.description: Hitting an enemy with no armor grants +50% headshot damage for 8s.

weaponTalents.name: First Blood
weaponTalents.description: If scoped, your first shot fired from out of combat or after fully reloading from empty deals headshot damage to any part of the body hit. Requires a Scope with 8x magnification or higher.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect First Blood
weaponTalents.description: If scoped, your first 2 shot fired from out of combat or after fully reloading from empty deals headshot damage to any part of the body hit. Requires a Scope with 8x magnification or higher.

weaponTalents.name: Outsider
weaponTalents.description: After killing an enemy, gain 100% optimal range and +100% accuracy for 10s.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Outsider
weaponTalents.description: After killing an enemy, gain 150% optimal range and +125% accuracy for 10s.

weaponTalents.name: Unwavering
weaponTalents.description: Swapping to this weapon grants +300% weapon handling for 5s. Kills refresh the buff. Swapping away disables this from all weapons for 5s.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Unwavering
weaponTalents.description: Swapping to this weapon grants +400% weapon handling for 5s. Kills refresh the buff. Swapping away disables this from all weapons for 5s.

weaponTalents.name: Unhinged
weaponTalents.description: Grants +18% weapon damage at the cost of -25% Stability and -25% Accuracy.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Unhinged
weaponTalents.description: Grants +22% weapon damage at the cost of -25% Stability and -25% Accuracy.

weaponTalents.name: Frenzy
weaponTalents.description: For every 10 bullets in the magazine capacity, gain +3% rate of fire and +3% weapon damage for 9s when reloading from empty.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Frenzy
weaponTalents.description: For every 8 bullets in the magazine capacity, gain +3% rate of fire and +3% weapon damage for 9s when reloading from empty.

weaponTalents.name: Overwhelm
weaponTalents.description: Suppressing an enemy, that is not currently suppressed, grants +10% weapon damage for 12 seconds. Max stack is 4.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Overwhelm
weaponTalents.description: Suppressing an enemy, that is not currently suppressed, grants +12% weapon damage for 12 seconds. Max stack is 4.

weaponTalents.name: Pummel
weaponTalents.description: 3 consecutive kills refills the magazine and grants +40% weapon damage for 10s.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Pummel
weaponTalents.description: 2 consecutive kills refills the magazine and grants +40% weapon damage for 10s.

weaponTalents.name: Pumped Up
weaponTalents.description: Reloading grants +1.2% weapon damage for 10s. Stacks up to 25 times.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Pumped Up
weaponTalents.description: Reloading grants +6% weapon damage for 10s. Stacks up to 5 times.

weaponTalents.name: Brazen
weaponTalents.description: Receive +3.5% Amplified Damage on the next shot with the weapon for each pellet that hits the target, if at least 6 pellets hit.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Brazen
weaponTalents.description: Receive +3.5% Amplified Damage on the next shot with the weapon for each pellet that hits the target, if at least 4 pellets hit.

weaponTalents.name: Salvage
weaponTalents.description: Killing a target has a +70% chance to refill the magazine.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Salvage
weaponTalents.description: Killing a target has a +85% chance to refill the magazine.

weaponTalents.name: Finisher
weaponTalents.description: Swapping from this weapon within 10s of killing an enemy grants 30% critical hit chance and 30% critical hit damage for 15s.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Finisher
weaponTalents.description: Swapping from this weapon within 10s of killing an enemy grants 35% critical hit chance and 40% critical hit damage for 15s.

weaponTalents.name: Back and Forth
weaponTalents.description: Swapping to this weapon grants +10% Rate of Fire and +9% Weapon Damage for 10s. Swapping from this weapon grants +5% Rate of Fire and +4.5% Weapon Damage for 10s. Receiving one of the bonus groups will remove the other if it's still active. Two instances of this talent will not function at the same time.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Back and Forth
weaponTalents.description: Swapping to this weapon grants +13% Rate of Fire and +12% Weapon Damage for 10s. Swapping from this weapon grants +5% Rate of Fire and +4.5% Weapon Damage for 10s. Receiving one of the bonus groups will remove the other if it's still active. Two instances of this talent will not function at the same time.

weaponTalents.name: Head Scratcher
weaponTalents.description: Deal 30% Amplified Damage to confused enemies. After 4 kills, applies Confuse to the enemy you hit.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Head Scratcher
weaponTalents.description: Deal 35% Amplified Damage to confused enemies. After 3 kills, applies Confuse to the enemy you hit.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Allegro
weaponTalents.description: 12% rate of fire.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Accurate
weaponTalents.description: 30% accuracy.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Extra
weaponTalents.description: +30% magazine capacity.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Distance
weaponTalents.description: +25% optimal range.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Jazz Hands
weaponTalents.description: 50% reload speed.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Optimized
weaponTalents.description: 20% weapon handling.

weaponTalents.name: Actum Est
weaponTalents.description: Shooting an enemy with this weapon will give 1 stack. At 100 stacks the next magazine will be 100% filled with shock ammo.

weaponTalents.name: Adaptive Instincts
weaponTalents.description: Hitting 30 headshots grants 20% critical hit chance and 50% critical hit damage for 45 seconds. Hitting 65 body shots grants 90% weapon damage for 45 seconds. Hitting 20 leg shots grants 150% reload speed for 45 seconds. Buffs refresh when out of combat.

weaponTalents.name: Agonizing Bite
weaponTalents.description: Diamondback randomly marks an enemy within 20m. If no enemies are within 20m, it marks the enemy closest to you. Hitting that enemy consumes the mark, guaranteeing a critical hit with damage amplified by 20%. After hitting a mark, all shots fired are guaranteed critical hits for 5 seconds. A new random enemy is marked afterwards and whenever you reload.

weaponTalents.name: Ardent
weaponTalents.description: Shooting heats up the weapon, filling up heat meter. The meter is equivalent to 50% of the weapon's standard Magazine Size. When the meter is full, rounds shot by the weapon will ignite enemies. When not shooting, the meter depletes over time. Reloading or swapping the weapon fully depletes the meter.

weaponTalents.name: Autentico
weaponTalents.description: +35 Weapon Damage. +100% accuracy. No Damage Drop Off. These bonuses are built into the weapon's base stats.

weaponTalents.name: Big Game Hunter
weaponTalents.description: When scoped, switches to semi-automatic fire mode, dealing 450% weapon damage with each shot. Headshots grant +6% headshot damage. Stacks up to 25 times. Once at full stacks, 10 stacks decay every 4 seconds until all stacks have been removed. Headshots delay decaying of stacks.

weaponTalents.name: Binary Trigger
weaponTalents.description: This weapon fires on trigger pull and release. If both bullets hit the same enemy, gain a stack. At 7 stacks, shooting an enemy deals 500% amplified damage and creates a 7m explosion dealing 500% weapon damage, consuming the stacks.

weaponTalents.name: Blossom Harvest
weaponTalents.description: Amplifies Weapon Damage by 3.3% for each 10% combined Armor and Health the enemy has remaining.

weaponTalents.name: Breathe Free
weaponTalents.description: When moving, gain 4 stacks per second, or 8 stacks if sprinting. Max stack is equal to the weapon's Magazine Size. Each round fired consumes a stack, amplifying damage by 75%. Kills grant +20% movement speed for 10s.

weaponTalents.name: Bullet Hell
weaponTalents.description: This weapon never needs to be reloaded. For every 100 bullets that hit an enemy, replenish some ammo to you and all your allies' reserves.

weaponTalents.name: Busy Little Bee
weaponTalents.description: Each shot to a different target will give 1 stack, up to 10, each stack will give 20% amplified weapon damage increase. Stacks will activate once the agent switches weapon and will last for 10 seconds.

weaponTalents.name: Caduceus
weaponTalents.description: Critical hits repair you and your allies for 3% of the hit's dealt damage.

weaponTalents.name: Capacitance
weaponTalents.description: Shooting enemies builds stacks to a cap of 40. Each stack grants 1.5% Skill Damage. After 5 seconds, stacks decay 1 per second. For each skill tier gain 7.5% Weapon Damage.

weaponTalents.name: Capitulate
weaponTalents.description: Hitting an enemy applies -4% Movement Speed for each pellet hit for 5 seconds. Shooting the enemy again will reapply the stacks.

weaponTalents.name: Shakedown
weaponTalents.description: Body shots add 1 stack to the enemy for 10s. Max stacks: 4. Hitting a different enemy removes all stacks. This weapon deals +4% Amplified Damage per stack. Your next headshot on an enemy with stacks consumes all stacks, dealing +11% Amplified Damage per stack. Destroying an enemy's weakpoint causes them to take +30% Amplified Damage from you for 5s

weaponTalents.name: Cover Shooter
weaponTalents.description: Every bullet fired while in cover increases weapon damage by 1% up to 100%. The bonus lasts for 15 seconds. Getting a kill with this weapon while in cover resets the duration. The bonus damage is canceled by reloading, swapping weapons, or exiting combat.

weaponTalents.name: Disruptor Rounds
weaponTalents.description: Shooting an enemy marks that enemy and adds a stack to the agent up to a count of 50. Shooting a marked enemy refreshes the mark and adds stacks to the agent. When you deploy a non-shield skill, remove all stacks on agent and all marked targets trigger an effect. 1-10 Stacks: Pulse marked targets for 5 seconds. 11-25 Stacks: Pulse and Disrupt marked targets for 5 seconds. 26-49 Stacks: Pulse, Disrupt, and Disorient marked targets for 5 seconds. 50 Stacks: Pulse, Disrupt, and Disorient marked targets and all hostiles within 10 meters of the marked targets. This effect will trigger immediately if any marked enemy is killed.

weaponTalents.name: Doctor Home
weaponTalents.description: Shooting an enemy with this weapon will apply a mark for 5 seconds. If a marked target is killed it will give a 10% armor repair kit which applies to the whole party. The kit will not give bonus armor.

weaponTalents.name: Eagle's Strike / Tenacity
weaponTalents.description: Accuracy increases as you continuously fire, up to 30%. Headshot kills grant the Tenacity buff for 15 seconds. The strength of Tenacity is increased by 1% for body shots and 5% for headshots. Tenacity: 40-80% of damage taken is delayed until the buff expires. All of the total delayed damage is reduced for each enemy killed while the buff is active, up to 100%.

weaponTalents.name: Electromagnetic Accelerator
weaponTalents.description: Shots fired deal 0-100% weapon damage based on how long the trigger is held before releasing.

weaponTalents.name: Faster Than Reloading
weaponTalents.description: Having this weapon holstered for 5s reloads and primes it. While primed, swapping to this weapon reloads your Primary and Secondary weapons and grants +20% Rate of Fire and +50% Weapon Damage until its magazine is emptied. Reloading or swapping from this weapon before its magazine is emptied will remove its stat bonuses.

weaponTalents.name: Full Stop
weaponTalents.description: Shooting enemies builds stacks to a cap of 20. Headshots grant 2 stacks. Each stack grants 2% Weapon Damage and 5% Headshot Damage. On reload, clear all stacks and gain 5% of your max armor as temp armor for 10 seconds for each stack removed. Headshot kills with Dread Edict restore all bullets in the magazine. This does not count as a reload.

weaponTalents.name: Gangland Hit
weaponTalents.description: Shooting an enemy with this weapon applies a mark. You can only apply one mark at a time. Shooting another enemy will transfer the mark. More marks can be applied on the same enemy by other agents using this weapon. Maximum amount of marks that can be applied on an enemy is 4. This weapon deals +20% Amplified Damage to marked enemies. The bonus is increased by 5% for each extra mark on the enemy other than your own

weaponTalents.name: Geri and Freki
weaponTalents.description: On trigger pull, fire both barrels at once. When fired from the right shoulder, hits add offensive primers, and defensive primers when fired from the left shoulder. Hits from one shoulder will detonate all of the opposite shoulder's primers when present. When detonated, each offensive primer deals 100% weapon damage, while each defensive primer grants +4% bonus armor and +10% amplified damage to armor plates for 5s. Primer effectiveness is doubled at 10 stacks.

weaponTalents.name: Hidden Rock
weaponTalents.description: Headshots apply confuse. Cooldown 20s.

weaponTalents.name: High Priority Target
weaponTalents.description: Amplifies Weapon Damage by 125% to the highest ranking enemies currently in combat, as per the Tier hierarchy. Tier 1: Hunter, Rogue, Leader, Tank, Shield, Heavy Weapons, RPG, Medic, Controller, Warhound, Marauder. Tier 2: Support, Engineer, Bodyguard, Immobilizer, Bomber, Mini Tank, Drone Operator. Tier 3: Any other enemy or skill proxy.

weaponTalents.name: In Plain Sight
weaponTalents.description: Your scoped view displays additional information about enemies not targeting you. Headshot and weakpoint damage against enemies not targeting you is amplified by 50%. Headshot kills reset the cooldown of your Decoy Skill. This bonus will wait until the Decoy goes on cooldown if currently active.

weaponTalents.name: Incessant Chatter
weaponTalents.description: When you reload, rate of fire is increased by 25% for each enemy within 15m for the duration of that magazine. Max stacks: 5. Kills refill 50% of your magazine.

weaponTalents.name: Liberty or Death
weaponTalents.description: Hits grant +2% weapon damage. Stacks up to 30 times. Headshots consume all stacks, repairing your shield for 3% per stack.

weaponTalents.name: Mosquito Song
weaponTalents.description: Hitting an enemy applies a stack. Stacks are shared between players. At 5 stacks, the enemy will forcefully target the last player to apply a stack for 5s and take 25% more damage to armor. Stacks deplete every 5s. Activating the effect on an enemy will remove all stacks from other enemies.

weaponTalents.name: Ortiz Assault Interface
weaponTalents.description: While scoped, the weapon will highlight a random body section of each enemy. The weapon amplifies damage by +60% Weapon Damage to highlighted body sections.

weaponTalents.name: Pakhan
weaponTalents.description: Each kill with this weapon gains a stack of 75% Base Magazine Size increase to the next magazine, up to 4 stacks.

weaponTalents.name: Payment in Kind
weaponTalents.description: Dealing damage to enemies adds a stack of 2% Critical Hit Damage, up to 100 stacks, lasting 10s. On reload apply a 10s bleed to yourself, which deals 0.5% armor damage per stack.

weaponTalents.name: Perturb
weaponTalents.description: While this weapon is holstered, generate 50% less Threat when shooting. Keeping this weapon holstered for 10s will Prime it. While primed, swapping to this weapon grants +25% Rate of Fire, +30% Weapon Damage and you generate 100% more Threat when Shooting for 20s. Swapping from this weapon before the timer ends removes the bonuses.

weaponTalents.name: Plague of the Outcasts
weaponTalents.description: Hits apply a debuff dealing 100% weapon damage over 10s. This stacks up to 50 times. Whenever an enemy dies with this debuff, the stacks are transferred to a nearby enemy within 25m.

weaponTalents.name: Primer Rounds
weaponTalents.description: Damaged enemies lose 50% burn resistance for 5 seconds.

weaponTalents.name: Regicide
weaponTalents.description: Headshot Kills create a 5m explosion, dealing 400% weapon damage and applying bleed to all enemies hit.

weaponTalents.name: Restrained
weaponTalents.description: The pistol is fully automatic and deals +25% Amplified Damage for 20s after your Shield gets broken.

weaponTalents.name: Rule Them All
weaponTalents.description: When the agent has a Status Effect applied to them, 50% of the ammo in their next magazine will apply the same Status Effect to their targets. This effect will only occur during combat.

weaponTalents.name: Sandman
weaponTalents.description: Melee attacks instantly kill non-elite enemies. Cooldown: 15s.

weaponTalents.name: Septic Shock
weaponTalents.description: Shooting a target applies stacks of venom, which last for 10s. Increasing stacks add more severe debuffs to the target. 2 - Poison. 4 - Disorient. 6 - Shock. 9 - Target takes additional 20% damage (from all sources). Stacks no longer increase. Duration of Status Effects is based on percentage of pellets hit on applying shot.

weaponTalents.name: Sport Mode
weaponTalents.description: +20% Movement Speed. This bonus does not stack with other Movement Speed bonuses.

weaponTalents.name: Swift
weaponTalents.description: Performing a cover to cover grants +20% weapon damage for 20s.

weaponTalents.name: Symbiosis
weaponTalents.description: While having a Shield deployed, lose Shield Health at a rate of 10% per second. Your Shield receives repairs of 25% of the damage dealt by this weapon.

weaponTalents.name: The Trap
weaponTalents.description: Tags enemies when in scope (maximum 10). If Agent kills any marked target with a headshot, all other targets will have 50% (20% PVP) movement speed and receive burn for 10 seconds. Cooldown 30 seconds. Killing another enemy with a headshot will shorten the cooldown for 10 seconds. Targets are marked after 1 second in crosshair.

weaponTalents.name: Transfusion
weaponTalents.description: Hitting headshots builds stacks up to a max of 8. When shooting an Ally or Skill, repair them for 50% of the shot damage for each stack. Healed Allies receive 200% of your Repair Skills bonus as Bonus Armor for each stack for 10 seconds. All hits become guaranteed headshots for 8 seconds after healing an Ally or Skill while at maximum stacks.

weaponTalents.name: Unnerve
weaponTalents.description: Killing an enemy will apply a mark on every enemy within 20m of it. Multiple marks can be applied to the same enemy. Max number of marks that can be applied to an enemy is 5. All marks on an enemy will disappear 10s after the last one has been applied. Deal +15% Amplified Damage per mark to marked enemies.

weaponTalents.name: You can look...but you can't touch
weaponTalents.description: When out of combat, receive 10 stacks. This weapon deals +12.5% Amplified Damage per stack. 1 stack is automatically consumed to fully repair one instance of damage you receive. 1 stack replenishes every 3s.

weaponTalents.name: Boiling Point
weaponTalents.description: The first 53% of your magazine will have -100% Critical Hit Chance. The rest will have 100%.

weaponTalents.name: Perfect Boiling Point
weaponTalents.description: The first 48% of your magazine will have -100% Critical Hit Chance. The rest will have 100%.

weaponTalents.name: Dragon's Breath
weaponTalents.description: This weapon fires Dragon's Breath shells. Each shot has a 40% chance of applying Burn to the enemy. An enemy cannot be applied Burn if they are burning already. Weapon Damage is Amplified by 50% of your Status Effects bonus.
